'''2012 European Championship Michael Willis LS Hoth: Main Power Generators''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Willis]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif|label=Hoth: Main Power Generators}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
